name: Lance
source:
Lance is Karma's younger brother who only ever appears in the fandisc, Cinderella Phenomenon: Evermore. He appears in the game as he is visiting Angielle, either to accompany Karma's visit to Angielle or to visit Karma in one of the routes.

[Taken from Cinderella Phenomenon wiki]
